WalkMark support request
Describe what you need help with. WalkMark does not attach diagnostics or private walk data automatically.
How do I get started?
WalkMark is a private, local-first walk journal. Start a walk from the main screen and stop it when you finish.
How do I start or stop a walk?
Use Start Walk on the main screen. While recording, use Stop Walk to end the active recording.
Why does WalkMark request location permission?
Location permission is required to record your route during an active walk. Grant the permission from the visible Start Walk action.
What should I do if GPS tracking is unavailable?
Confirm that device location is enabled and WalkMark has location permission. Then return to the main screen and try starting the walk again.
Where is my walk information stored?
Walk data is stored locally on your device. WalkMark does not silently upload routes, locations, notes, photos, logs, or diagnostics.
How do I contact support?
If a support email is configured for this build, use Contact support by email. You review and send the message in your email application.
